decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans JS/01 submitted 07/06/2011 & 201 Hatton Rd, Bedfont submitted 01/09/2011  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extension  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 201 Hatton Road, Bedfont.

Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 6 - The crossover shall not exceed 3.6m wide.
description: Change of use of the existing garage to bedroom with en-suite level access shower room and the relocation of the existing crossover.
